ALD.Title: Assets Doctor
ALD.Subtitle: Finds missing files and replaces their paths. Nothing changes until you apply.
ALD.Empty: Nothing to show with these filters.
ALD.MoreRefs: ... and {n} more uses (use the CSV to see all)

Copy.Title: Copy assets to a folder
Copy.BasedOn: Based on the last scan ({scope}): {n} paths. Scan again with more options if you need compendiums.
Copy.DestHelp: Pick the folder where the copies go. The folders images, videos, sounds and other are created inside it.
Copy.LayoutFlat: All files straight into the type folders
Copy.LayoutHelp: Keeping folders avoids name clashes and is the only way wildcards can be updated.
Copy.Strip: Remove this beginning from the original paths (optional)
Copy.StripHelp: Shortens the copied folder tree. Example: REPOSITORIO/Alien/x.png becomes Alien/x.png.
Copy.IncludePackages: Include files from other modules and systems
Copy.IncludePackagesHelp: Off by default. Art from other packages may have license limits, and its owners already distribute it.
Copy.Relink: Also update the world's paths to the copies
Copy.RelinkHelp: Needed to build a module from this world. Shows a preview, saves a backup and can be undone. Off: copy only, the world is not changed.
Copy.DestInvalid: The destination must be inside your Data folder and cannot be a Foundry core folder.
Copy.NoTypes: Select at least one file type.
Copy.PlanNote: Every file passes through your browser, so big files take time. Avoid editing the world and use Foundry as little as possible while copying. Running again skips what was already copied.
Copy.NothingToCopy: Nothing to copy with these choices.
Copy.RelinkConfirm: Update {paths} paths in {docs} documents ({uses} uses) to point to the copies? This writes to your world data.
Copy.WasCancelled: The copy was cancelled before the end. Run it again to continue where it stopped.

RelinkNot.nodocs: The documents to update could not be found.
RelinkNot.declined: World paths were not changed (you chose to keep only the copies).
RelinkNot.backup: Paths were not changed because the backup could not be saved.

Copy.AllCopied: Everything that could be copied was copied.
Copy.UndoNote: This only restores the world's paths. The copied files stay in the destination folder.

Reason.inactive: Data of a module that is not active
Reason.folder: A module's search folder (not a file)
Reason.package: File from another module or system
Reason.relink_failed: The copy failed, so the path was not updated
Reason.relink_notreplaceable: A path the module cannot replace (bare name or setting)
Reason.relink_wildmoved: Wildcard not updated (files ended up in different folders)
Reason.relink_wildrenamed: Wildcard not updated (the upload renamed the files and the pattern no longer finds them)

Copy.AcceptResized: Accept files that another module changed during upload
Copy.AcceptResizedHelp: Off by default. Some modules convert or rename files on upload (for example media-optimizer and filepicker-plus), so the copy ends up a different size than the original. On: the copy is accepted and the world path points to the file that was really uploaded.
Copy.ResizedHint: {n} files came out a different size after upload. This is usually another module converting or renaming files on upload (for example media-optimizer or filepicker-plus). Turn that module off and run again, or tick "Accept files that another module changed during upload" and run again. The world paths of these files were not changed.
Copy.OptimizerWarn: Active modules that change files on upload: {list}. They can convert images (for example PNG and JPG to WebP) or rename files, so the copy is no longer identical to the original. For exact copies, turn those modules off and reload Foundry. Or tick "Accept files that another module changed during upload" below: the world paths will then point to the converted files.
Copy.BackupTipTitle: Before changing any path: make Foundry's own world backup
Copy.BackupTipText: Close this world, open Setup, right-click the world and choose Backup. It works as a second safety net next to this module's backup (which only keeps the old values of what it changes). It is an extra precaution and takes a few seconds.
Copy.UsedBy: Copied files by where they are used: {list}.

ALD.NotGM: Only the GM can use Assets Doctor.

D.SystemOther: This path belongs to system '{id}', which is not this world's system.
D.Missing: File not found in the folder.
D.Case: Different upper/lower case. The real file is: {name}
D.WrongType: Type does not fit the field (expected: {expected}, found: {found}).
D.WildEmptyDir: Wildcard matched nothing and the folder does not exist.
D.WildEmpty: No files found for this wildcard.
D.WildWrong: {n} files, none of the expected type ({expected}).
D.WildMixed: {n} files, {bad} are not the expected type ({expected}).
D.FolderMissing: The search folder does not exist.
D.InactiveOwner: Data from module {id}. Ignored because the module is not active. (Status: {was})
D.Placeholder: Looks like an example value saved by a module, not a real file.
D.FromFlag: Comes from data of module '{id}', which is not installed.
D.MissingInDir: File not found. The folder exists and has {n} files.

Menu.Name: Assets Doctor
Menu.Label: Open checker
Menu.Hint: Finds missing files in scenes, actors, journals, playlists and compendiums.

ALD.FiltersTitle: Filter the result list (it does not search new files, it only filters what the scan found)
ALD.FieldTextHelp: Shows only rows containing this text in the path or where it is used.
ALD.FieldFolderHelp: Shows only paths starting like this. Useful to check one module or folder.
ALD.FieldExtHelp: You can type several, separated by commas.
ALD.OptWorldHelp: Scenes, actors, items, journals, playlists, tables and macros of this world. Does not open compendiums.
ALD.OptModPacksHelp: Much slower. Only if you need it.
ALD.OptModuleHelp: Checks the compendiums of one module (useful when building a module).
ALD.NeedScope: Select at least one option above to scan.
ALD.OwnerTip: Module that saved this data inside the document

Pick.Title: Choose module
Pick.Help: Only active modules that have compendiums are listed. Pick one and click Choose (or double-click).
Pick.None: No active module has compendiums to check.

ALD.BulkTip: Replaces paths in every item in the list (filters apply).
ALD.UndoConfirm: Undo the last replacement? {n} documents go back to their previous value.
ALD.SearchPh: Filter by file, document or scene name...
ALD.ReplaceTip: Replace this file in all its uses

Rep.Title: Replace paths
Rep.TitleSingle: Replace this file in all its uses
Rep.NewPathHelp: Type or paste the path (with spaces or %20, either works) or use Browse to pick the new file.
Rep.BulkHint: Applies to the {n} items in the list (with the filters already applied). Tip: filter by type, extension or folder first.
Rep.OnlyExisting: Only replace when the new file exists
Rep.OnlyExistingHelp: Avoids swapping a broken link for another broken link.
Rep.BackupHelp: Saved in Data/{dir}/ and lets you undo the replacement. It is not a copy of the world. For a full copy, use Foundry's own backup: close the world, open Setup, right-click the world and choose Backup. Uncheck to replace without this backup.
Rep.BackupFailed: Could not save the backup file.
Rep.Summary: {paths} paths | {uses} uses | {ok} with an existing new file | {missing} without a new file
Rep.NothingToChange: No documents to change. {n} uses could not be located.
Rep.ConfirmText: Replace {paths} paths in {docs} documents ({uses} uses)? This writes to your world data.
Rep.ConfirmBackup: A backup will be saved in Data/{dir}/ before anything changes.
Rep.Unresolved: {n} uses could not be located automatically (they may live in other modules' data).
Rep.RescanNote: The list will refresh with a new scan.
Rep.NoMatch: No item in the list matches this rule.
Rep.TypeToPreview: Type above to see the preview.
Rep.MoreRows: ... and {n} more items (all will be replaced).
Rep.BackupDownloaded: Could not save to Data/{dir}/. The backup was downloaded by your browser instead.
Rep.BackupAbort: The backup could not be saved, so nothing was changed. Uncheck the backup option to continue without it.
Rep.BrowseFind: Browse for the folder or file to find
Rep.BrowseRepl: Browse for the new folder or file

ALD.SettingsButtonTip: Open the asset checker and replacer
ALD.HideTip: Hide for now. It stays out of the list until you show it again in the Hidden tab.
ALD.UnhideTip: Bring this item back into the list
ALD.EmptyHidden: Nothing hidden. Use a row's Hide button to take it out of the list for now.
ALD.CopyAssetsTip: Copies the files this world uses into a folder you choose (for example a module's folder)
ALD.RestoreBackupTip: Restores the old values from a backup file saved in Data/asset-doctor/<world>/
ALD.RestoreBadFile: This file is not an Assets Doctor backup.
ALD.RestoreOtherWorld: This backup is from the world "{world}" and cannot be restored in this world.
ALD.RestoreNothing: The backup has nothing to restore.
ALD.RestoreConfirm: Restore {n} documents with the values from the backup made on {date}? If you changed the same fields of these documents afterwards, those changes will be lost.
ALD.RestoreProblems: {missing} documents were not found and {failed} failed.
